contains: Nothing lives here but the echo.
In the coracle you see a Hunter.
The Wumpus, in the distance, to the east.
The Bottomless Pit, in the distance, to the northwest.
The Landing, in the distance, to the west.
The Bone Hollow, on the horizon, to the northeast.
The arrow goes out across the water and is gone. Somewhere in the dark, something snorts.
The arrow goes out across the water and is gone.
The water heaves, the coracle tips, and the Wumpus has you. It does not hurry.
